system.description: Base Essence (Elemental Companion) 5.14.3 - Elemental Companions. Calming and befriending hybrid elemental animals, summoning and controlling/mastering a hybrid animal or an Elemental Steed, silent and long-range commands to a bonded animal, locating mastered animals, riding bonuses on an elemental mount, calling a mount to the caster, and eventually summoning/controlling/mastering a Lesser Riding Drake. Fidelity notes: levels 3 and 8 are intentionally blank in the source (no spell printed); the table prints "M" as the Type for most of the animal-control spells on this list, which isn't one of this system's valid Type values (E/BE/DE/F/P/U/I) - normalized to U here.

While the caster concentrates, a single hybrid elemental animal is calmed and will not attack. Attacking a calmed creature while this spell is in effect will break it and make it harder to cast this spell again on the same creature, giving it a +20 to resist this spell for a week.
For the duration, the target hybrid elemental animal will believe the caster is a good friend. Attacking the creature will negate this spell. This spell lasts 1 round per 5% failure.
As Calm Hybrid I, except two animals are affected.

Caster summons a hybrid elemental animal of the same type as his chosen element. Animal is stationary for three rounds after summoning due to disorientation. If not controlled or mastered the animal will act according to its nature, if from this plane, or dissolve if an elemental spirit was called to animate a form.

Caster controls target hybrid elemental animal like it was a well-trained animal (note: this is not absolute control) while the caster concentrates. It can be commanded to attack, fetch, etc. If severely wounded it will retreat like a mundane animal. Concentration for this spell is not intense and only takes 20% of the caster's actions.
Sends a command to the caster's bonded animal that is inaudible to all but the animal. The animal must be within earshot.

Caster summons an Elemental Steed of the same type as his chosen element. The steed is stationary for three rounds after summoning due to disorientation. If not controlled or mastered the mount will act according to its nature, if from this plane, or dissolve, if an elemental spirit was called to animate the form.
As Control Hybrid, except for duration. The caster may only have one hybrid animal mastered at a time and it must be of the same element as the caster's chosen element.

Caster controls the target Elemental Steed like it was a well-trained horse. It can be ridden and understands the commands common to a well-trained horse. Concentration for this spell is not intense and only takes 20% of the caster's actions.
Caster knows the location of all of his mastered animals if within the radius of this spell.
Caster sends a command to the animal that is out of caster's ear shot. Caster must know the location of the animal through the Locate Animal spell.
Caster gains +20 to Riding maneuvers and mounted combat while on an Elemental Steed (includes Elemental Riding Drakes) for the duration.
As Control Steed, except for the duration. The caster may only have a single mount mastered at a time and it must be of the same elemental type as the caster.
Caster specifies one animal bonded to them. If it is within range, it is transported instantly to the caster's left side.
As Silent Command, except it does not require the animal to be within earshot.
Calls the caster's mount (includes Elemental Riding Drakes) so it will come to where he is or as close as possible to where he is. This is a loud audible call.
Caster gains a +30 to Riding maneuver and Mounted Combat while on an elemental mount for the spell's duration (includes Elemental Riding Drakes).
As Summon Mount, except the mount is a Lesser Riding Drake.
As Control Mount, except it affects Lesser Riding Drakes of the same element as the caster's chosen element.
As Call Mount, except the call is silent.
As Control Lesser Riding Drake, except for the duration. The caster may only have a single mount (steed or riding drake) mastered at a time and it must be of the same elemental type as the caster.
